name: Motorcycle Simulator Montana
summary:
Ride Billings, Montana, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

29 KM ROUND BILLINGS
I-90 west along the Yellowstone River, past the South Side and King Avenue, then north through the West End to the foot of the Rims. Rimrock Road runs east under the sandstone cliffs past Rocky Mountain College, then 27th Street drops into downtown past the First Interstate Center, Montana's tallest building.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
Grip the bars with your own hands. Roll your right wrist to open the throttle, brake
